title: Jade: why a cool, smooth stone became a symbol of prosperity
body: Jade has been carved and worn for thousands of years, especially across East Asia, where it stands for balance, protection and good fortune. These are cultural associations, not scientific claims. What anyone can verify is the feel: dense, cool to the touch, and warm slowly in the hand.

title: Split gates and quiet temples: a walk through Bali
body: Carved stone gates, offerings set out each morning, and rice terraces that turn every road into a slow one. Bali's architecture is built from volcanic stone, and you notice how weathering and moss become part of the design rather than damage to it.

title: A slow desk: small rituals for working without noise
body: One stone on the desk, one cup, one task at a time. The point is not the object but the pause it creates. Choosing quiet routines is a way of staying off the grid in a very connected world.
